params.name: status
params.description:
Filter invites by [status](#object-status).

Multiple status values can be searched at once using either method:

1. `/v2/invites?status=sent,initiated`
2. `/v2/invites?status=sent&status=initiated`

params.name: reply_to
params.description: Filter invites for a specific [`reply_to`](#object-reply_to) email.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of invite objects returned [per page](/api-guide/overview#pagination). Default: 10. Maximum: 200.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The URL returned in `next` or `previous` used to retrieve another [page](/api-guide/overview#pagination) of results.

params.name: id

Invalidates a previously sent invite.

If a user clicks a revoked invite URL, the landing page will notify the user the invite has expired.
